description: Rehearsal 7 persistence requirements: historical defects linked to the requirements and tests that close them, and every Rehearsal 6 baseline obligation the change supersedes. Checked by tools/validate-r7-persistence-requirements.fsx.

defects.title: Cross-tab lost updates
defects.summary: Without navigator.locks, several tabs read, merged and wrote one shared device store without exclusion; the changes of one or two tabs were lost on every run (AR-035-O4, no-locks half).
defects.rootCause: A device-local store shared by every tab of the origin needs cross-tab exclusion that the browser does not guarantee.
defects.resolution: Removed by design: no shared browser storage for investigations, no cross-tab locking, and tabs are independent GitHub writers resolved by expected-head commits.

defects.title: Offline retry loop
defects.summary: A save that could not be sent was retried with no backoff, 151 POSTs in 60 s for one change, while the page said 'Saving to GitHub'.
defects.rootCause: An offline synchronization queue retried unsendable writes automatically, and its state was projected as Saving.
defects.resolution: No offline queue; a save requested offline sends nothing and shows Offline; automatic mutations and reconciliation reads are capped per save request.

defects.title: Spurious conflict for a single writer
defects.summary: After saving investigation B, a change to investigation A in the same tab was refused as a conflict and left unsaved, because the branch head had moved for an unrelated investigation.
defects.rootCause: A stale head was treated as a conflict without checking whether the investigation's own files had changed.
defects.resolution: A stale head over unrelated changes rebases automatically, within a limit.

defects.title: Network failure on the rebase path reported as a conflict
defects.summary: When the write could not be sent on the rebase path, the page said another writer had changed the repository and offered Discard; no other writer existed.
defects.rootCause: Failure classification did not separate a network failure from a stale head, and the conflict path offered a destructive recovery.
defects.resolution: Provider answers are classified from typed content; a network failure is never a conflict; Discard is offered only in a genuine conflict and after confirmation.

defects.title: Acceptance judge accepts a false cause
defects.summary: UI-010-O2's test judge checked only that a message was long and mentioned preservation and a next step, so the false conflict text of RF-F-3 passed.
defects.rootCause: The test did not compare the stated cause with the determined cause.
defects.resolution: Messages must state the determined cause, and PAT-07 and PAT-14 check the cause, not only the message shape.

defects.title: Restore claimed Saved for device-only changes
defects.summary: After all tabs closed, a restore adopted only the page's own writer record and showed 'Saved to GitHub (confirmed …)' for other writers' changes that existed only on the device.
defects.rootCause: Save state was restored from browser storage rather than derived from a GitHub confirmation.
defects.resolution: Nothing is restored from browser storage; Saved is constructible only from a read-back confirmation; reopening loads from GitHub.

defects.title: Another investigation's save state shown
defects.summary: An investigation's page showed another investigation's save state, so a change that never reached GitHub read 'Saved to GitHub'.
defects.rootCause: One workspace-level sync state was rendered on every investigation page.
defects.resolution: Each investigation has its own save state, and the workspace summary may not contradict it.

defects.title: Header contradicts the workspace
defects.summary: The header said the workspace had no investigation while it held investigations saved to GitHub.
defects.rootCause: The header's connection label was not derived from the investigations it summarized.
defects.resolution: The workspace summary is derived from the investigations' save states.

defects.title: Web Locks used instead of a cross-tab library (deviation D-07)
defects.summary: AR-035-O4 was met with a Web Locks exclusive section and a fallback that did not hold without Web Locks; Arca 0.6.0 stayed unused.
defects.rootCause: The requirement demanded a shared durable device store, which needs cross-tab exclusion.
defects.resolution: The requirement for a shared device store is superseded, so no cross-tab exclusion mechanism, Web Locks or library, is needed.
